title: Receipts/GeneratedFormatterHonoursAttributesTests.cs: edge-case test passes on head (2 tests): no defect shown; refutes 1 lens claim(s): requirement-tests-1

refutes.claim: When the formatted type carries MessagePack attributes, they are ignored, which misses the acceptance criterion "If T does carry MessagePack attributes, they are honoured". With no SurrogateType, the collector always takes the contractless path (`CreateContractlessMembers`). It never inspects `[MessagePackObject]`, `[Key]`, `[IgnoreMember]`, `[DataContract]`, `[DataMember]` or `[IgnoreDataMember]` on T. So a T marked `[MessagePackObject]` with `[Key(0)]` and `[IgnoreMember]` gets a string-keyed map that includes the ignored member. Per the maintainer comment, contractless mode should apply only when T has no `[DataContract]` or `[MessagePackObject]`.
